suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 is about the Kotlin compiler's build cache. We don't compile Kotlin: we only get the kotlin-stdlib runtime library because Javalin depends on it, and the compiler code the CVE is in isn't part of that jar. Checked 2026-11-10. Expires so someone looks again (and drop it once Javalin moves to a Kotlin version the NVD no longer flags).
